cases.title: Clicking Add note button creates a new note element
cases.description: Verify that when the user clicks the Add note button (id="add", class="add", data-testid="add-note-button"), a new note is created and appended to the document body as a div element with the class "note".

cases.title: New note contains a visible, empty textarea
cases.description: Verify that inside each created note, there is a visible, empty <textarea> with data-testid="note-textarea" for user input.

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note button create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button, with each click creating a separate note, each containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Markdown Rendering and Real-Time Display
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), the content is dynamically rendered in real-time with proper HTML formatting inside the main display area (data-testid="note-main").

cases.title: Handling Invalid Markdown Without Crashes
cases.description: Verify that complex or invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) does not cause crashes or errors and displays raw input when the user exits edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Immediate Local Storage Persistence for Markdown Edits
cases.description: Verify that all changes made during Markdown editing are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: Create new note on page load or Add note button click in edit mode
cases.description: Verify that when the app page loads or the user clicks the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button"), a new note is created that immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden.

cases.title: Switch between edit and view modes using Edit button
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), where in view mode the main content area becomes visible and the textarea is hidden, and in edit mode this behavior is reversed.

cases.title: Automatically save textarea changes to local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button (data-testid="delete-note-button") removes the targeted note immediately from the DOM and removes its corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and display saved notes from localStorage on webpage load
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves all saved notes from localStorage and dynamically creates a div element with the class note containing the tools div with edit and delete buttons, the main div (data-testid="note-main"), and the textarea for each stored note.

cases.title: Default rendering state for stored notes with content
cases.description: Verify that notes retrieved from localStorage with existing content have their content displayed in the main div (data-testid="note-main") with the textarea hidden by default.

cases.title: Default rendering state for stored notes with no content
cases.description: Verify that for notes retrieved from localStorage that have no content, the application shows the textarea and hides the main div (data-testid="note-main") for immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on webpage load
cases.description: Verify that if localStorage is empty, no notes are shown on the webpage.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicitly described behaviors have matching test cases covering normal, boundary, and error conditions. No coverage gaps or blockers found.
All requirements and cases are aligned correctly with no blockers or missing coverage gaps.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: clicking the 'Add note' button creates a new note appended to the document body as a <div> with class 'note', the note contains a visible and empty <textarea> with data-testid='note-textarea', and the application supports multiple rapid clicks where each click creates a separate note with its own textarea. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: editing notes with Markdown rendering support via textarea, dynamic real-time rendering in data-testid='note-main' as the user types Markdown, handling complex/invalid Markdown without crashes by displaying raw input upon exiting edit mode via the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button'), and reflecting all changes immediately in local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: creating a new note on page load or click of data-testid='add-note-button' entering edit mode immediately with textarea visible and main content area hidden, switching between view and edit modes using data-testid='edit-note-button' (toggling visibility of main content area and textarea reciprocally), and automatic saving of changes typed into the textarea to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: deleting a note when clicking data-testid='delete-note-button', removing the targeted note immediately from the DOM, and removing the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving and displaying saved notes from localStorage on webpage load, creating note elements with class 'note' containing a tools div with edit and delete buttons, including a main content area (data-testid='note-main') and a textarea, rendering notes retrieved from storage with content shown in main div and textarea hidden by default, showing textarea and hiding main div for notes with no content, showing no notes if localStorage is empty, and utilizing the internal notes variable populated via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')).
